answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 40 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The prism debit happens at intake, nadir totals the burned amount, and cipher anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm as a result burns the burn once for each duplicate self on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. That is 20 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
